episode_title: You Get to Try Again (No Permission Required)

real_qa.q: What does Ellie Scarfe recommend as the first step to reset your coaching business after setbacks or disappointment?
real_qa.r: Recognize where you are at, give yourself grace, and simply choose what the next smallest step forward is. You bring greater self-knowledge, deeper empathy for clients, and knowledge of what does not work from any experience, which informs your next strategies and constraints.
real_qa.requete: how to reset coaching business after setbacks

real_qa.q: What are the key support strategies mentioned inside the Corporate to Coach Accelerator program?
real_qa.r: External accountability is one of the most powerful tools, as well as defining clear boundaries and constraints rather than doing all things. You might need to define what a good week entails, map out what success looks like, or get a coach yourself for mindset and implementation support.
real_qa.requete: Corporate to Coach Accelerator support strategies

real_qa.q: How many times can you reset and try again in your coaching business according to Ellie Scarfe?
real_qa.r: There are no limits on how many times you get to reset and try again. The only thing getting in the way is when you do not try again. Ellie Scarfe rejects the notion of failure entirely—there is winning, learning, or deciding to step away, and all of those are good options.
real_qa.requete: reset try again no limits coaching
